args.command: npm view lodash-es version 2>&1; echo "---dist-tags---"; npm view lodash-es dist-tags 2>&1; echo "---versions tail---"; npm view lodash-es versions --json 2>&1 | tail -20
npm config get registry 2>&1; echo "---"; cat .npmrc 2>&1; echo "---lockfile---"; ls -la; echo "---"; cat package-lock.json 2>&1 | head -40
cat package-lock.json; echo "---node_modules---"; ls -la node_modules; echo "---find any js in lodash-es---"; find node_modules/lodash-es -type f
